entity.firm: Crypto Tax Partners is the UK's specialist accountancy firm for cryptoasset holders. We handle Capital Gains Tax on disposals and swaps, staking and mining income, DeFi and NFT activity, HMRC nudge letters and voluntary disclosure, and Self Assessment for investors, traders, miners and crypto businesses. Crypto Tax Partners is a trading name of Ashfield Trading Ltd, company number 16358723, registered office 20 Ashfield Avenue, Shipley, Bradford, BD18 3AL.
entity.serves: We act for UK cryptoasset holders, from an individual investor with a handful of disposals to active traders, miners, stakers and businesses that hold or accept crypto.
entity.where: We act for clients across the United Kingdom and work remotely, by phone, video and email.
howItWorks: You tell us your situation through the enquiry form: what you hold, which exchanges and wallets you have used, and what you need looked at.
One of our accountants calls you to go through it and answer the immediate questions.
We agree the scope and a fixed fee in writing before any work starts.
We do the work, deal with HMRC on your behalf, and keep you ahead of your deadlines.
entity.next: We reply within 24 hours and one of our accountants comes back to you directly.
